#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Interactive single-client controller for the RoboTwin limited episode."""
import json
import pathlib
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot


OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/session")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print(json.dumps({"connected": r.base, "protocol": spec.get("protocol"),
                  "budgets": spec.get("budgets"), "action_types": spec.get("action_types"),
                  "proprio_groups": spec.get("proprio_groups"), "cameras": spec.get("cameras")}, default=str), flush=True)
seq = 0


def persist(res, label):
    global seq
    seq += 1
    path = OUT / f"{seq:03d}_{label}"
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for cam, img in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(img)).save(path / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
    for cam, vid in res.video.items():
        (path / f"{cam}.mp4").write_bytes(vid)
    for cam, arr in res.frames.items():
        np.save(path / f"{cam}_frames.npy", arr)
    if res.proprio is not None:
        np.save(path / "proprio.npy", res.proprio)
    (path / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=str))
    return str(path)


def report(res, label):
    p = res.meta.get("proprio")
    if isinstance(p, dict):
        now = p.get("now")
    else:
        now = None
    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "saved": persist(res, label), "meta": res.meta,
                      "proprio_now": now}, default=str), flush=True)


report(r.get_obs(video="none"), "initial")

for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        cmd = json.loads(line)
        op = cmd.get("op")
        if op == "obs":
            res = r.get_obs(cameras=tuple(cmd.get("cameras", ("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"))),
                            seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)), video=cmd.get("video", "none"),
                            video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 10)), include_depth=bool(cmd.get("include_depth", False)))
            report(res, cmd.get("label", "obs"))
        elif op == "ee":
            actions = np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32)
            if actions.ndim == 1:
                actions = actions[None, :]
            res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions, cameras=tuple(cmd.get("cameras", ("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"))),
                           video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"), video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 10)), note=cmd.get("note", ""))
            report(res, cmd.get("label", "ee"))
        elif op == "joint":
            actions = np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32)
            if actions.ndim == 1:
                actions = actions[None, :]
            res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 0.05)),
                           cameras=tuple(cmd.get("cameras", ("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"))),
                           video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"), video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 10)), note=cmd.get("note", ""))
            report(res, cmd.get("label", "joint"))
        elif op == "status":
            print(json.dumps(r.status(), default=str), flush=True)
        elif op == "quit":
            break
        else:
            print(json.dumps({"error": f"unknown op {op!r}"}), flush=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"exception": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)}), flush=True)
